name: Ore to Imouto no Kounai Play ~Imouto wa Dare ni mo Watasanai~
original_name: 俺と妹の校内プレイ～妹は誰にも渡さない～
source:
The main character has a younger sister, Sanami. She is pretty and he secretly loves her.... He keeps it secret and they live a peaceful life. But it is about to be destroyed when his friend tells Sanami that he loves her.... The main character decides to take action not to lose Sanami....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角有一个妹妹，Sanami。她很漂亮，他暗恋她……他保守秘密，他们过着平静的生活。但当他的朋友告诉萨那美他爱她时，一切即将被摧毁……主角决定采取行动不失去萨那美……

[来自工口游戏商店]
